verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins documents plugins that bundle MCP servers. Installed plugins add those servers' MCP tools to ChatGPT and Codex sessions, and the plugin-creator skill wires up MCP servers for custom plugins. The repo layout lists `.mcp.json` as a plugin surface. missing for 10: documented steps for plugging in an arbitrary third-party MCP server outside the plugin packaging/marketplace flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration that an MCP tool was actually invoked through an installed plugin.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Installed plugins can add skills and MCP tools to new chats.
A plugin can contain skills, MCP servers, or both.
The plugin-creator skill will create the plugin folder, create the required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, and add MCP server wiring for the plugin.
An MCP server that defines tools and exposes them to ChatGPT and Codex.
Install a plugin from a configured marketplace, then start a new session before using its bundled skills or tools.
